# Reproducible experiments

Record experiments that changed the project model, including negative results. Each record should name the question, target/environment provenance, setup and relevant tool/producer versions, exact procedure, expected differentiating outcomes, bounded artifact names, observed result, interpretation, confidence/evidence class, which hypotheses or roadmap items changed, and the next question.

When an experiment validates a derived mapping, parser, decoder, correlation, or machine-readable analysis artifact, record what makes the validation independent of the derivation itself. If the check is only a self-round-trip or internal-consistency check, say so explicitly.
